subject: cassiane-lockhart
q: CLOSED — both are citizens. The roster has no blanks.
detail:
CASSIANE LOCKHART is a CITIZEN. MIKAELA is a CITIZEN — the Archive had the wrong wife; ISOLDE is the survivor of that pair at 05-117.

Seventy-two women: 30 survivors, every one with a flight and a designation, and 42 citizens. No blanks, no inferences, nothing silently assumed. The roster took four passes of memory lists reconciled against evidence, and the three drifts it caught — Eirwen, Remielle and Tiffany — were all caught by flight numbers rather than by argument.
